items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: It wasn't guitar then. It was banjo. Yeah. It was Johnny. Johnny Dave. Johnny Dave.

ctx.x: He still plays the parades with the Eureka Band.

Oh, I think so. Yes. He's going that over with the drum. Oh, he was a wonderful drummer, that guy. Oh, my brother had some fine men with him. And during that time, let me see, who played guitar? I'm trying to think who played... It wasn't guitar then. It was banjo. Yeah. It was Johnny. Johnny Dave. Johnny Dave.
I don't know. Was there a fellow by the name of Kimball played? There was an old man, Kimball.
